reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes a Bitcoin trading pool requiring at least a $100 commitment and claims participants' Bitcoin will grow through daily compounding. It also offers financial rewards for referrals and for maintaining a $200 position while introducing one person on each side of the organization, subject to a waiting period. the available video evidence does not establish that trading occurred, bonuses were paid, or participants experienced a loss.

citations.quote: In Mirror Trading International there are three streams of income.
You join the trading pool with a minimum of $100 of Bitcoin. Your Bitcoin is traded for you from Monday to Friday.
This means you have personally introduced one person on the left and one person on the right of your business.
This will qualify you for the binary bonus and you will receive a weekly binary bonus for your smallest leg.
You will also need to have at least $200 in your own position.

opening.argument: The presentation includes a material qualification rather than an unqualified promise: it explains that the displayed U.S. dollar amount is only an indication and will fluctuate with Bitcoin's price. It also directs viewers to inspect the Bitcoin balance itself and review detailed reports and statements. That emphasis on volatility, underlying units, and account records is consistent with a transparent operational explanation, not a claim that returns are guaranteed. The video explains how the system is presented and how to interpret its figures; it does not state that every participant will profit or that losses are impossible.

citations.quote: The US dollar value is just an indication and will fluctuate with the Bitcoin price.
Check to make sure your Bitcoin is growing from day to day.
To view your daily trading result, you can simply click View detailed report

rebuttal.rebuttal: The minimum contribution and compounding description show the service's stated operating model, but they do not establish a guarantee. The referral and binary passages describe eligibility conditions and reporting locations, not deceptive concealment. The presentation expressly distinguishes Bitcoin balances from fluctuating dollar values, which undercuts an interpretation of certainty.

citations.quote: The US dollar value is just an indication and will fluctuate with the Bitcoin price.
You will need to be binary qualified to earn this bonus.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A warning that dollar values fluctuate does not resolve the central concern: the video still presents Bitcoin being traded for participants and describes daily growth through compounding. Explaining how to inspect a dashboard cannot establish that the underlying trading occurred or that the displayed balances were withdrawable. The qualifications describe conditions for bonuses, not meaningful disclosure of investment risk.

citations.quote: Your Bitcoin is traded for you from Monday to Friday.
the idea of Mirror Trading International is to grow your bitcoin daily
When these are released into your wallet you can either withdraw or reinvest into your trading pool.

opening.argument: The video's primary activity is a back-office walkthrough. It identifies where a member can find the trading-pool balance, detailed reports, statements, income-wallet information, and bonus reports, including the meaning of the unit called a bit. This is procedural education about navigating an account interface, not evidence of a solicitation aimed at obtaining credentials or an immediate payment. The closing instruction is also framed as support for questions: viewers are told to speak with their team leader. The dashboard examples demonstrate what categories and records are available, while the video does not claim that the screenshots alone prove a particular outcome.

citations.quote: Your Bitcoin Bonuses in the Mirror Trading International BackOffice
Let's look at your back office dashboard.
The values on statements are expressed in bits.
For more information please speak to your team leader.

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling the material a tutorial does not erase the financial subject, but it accurately describes what the video actually does: it teaches viewers to locate and interpret records. The prosecution identifies stated features of the organization, yet it does not point to a request for passwords, a fabricated personal success story, or proof that the walkthrough is anything other than an operational demonstration.

citations.quote: To view your daily trading result, you can simply click View detailed report
go to the internal fund transfer and this will show you your income wallet balance

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Operational instructions can also function as promotion. The title centers Bitcoin bonuses, and the walkthrough repeatedly explains how participants can receive, reinvest, or withdraw purported income. The absence of a credential request or personal testimonial does not make the financial claims reliable; the displayed dashboard and instructions still do not verify actual trading, payment, or recoverability of funds.

citations.quote: Your Bitcoin Bonuses in the Mirror Trading International BackOffice
When these are released into your wallet you can either withdraw or reinvest into your trading pool.
This will show you the total of everything that has come to your income wallet to date.

opening.argument: The referral material can be read as an ordinary promotional reward attached to participation in a service, with explicit conditions rather than a hidden mechanism. It states a direct referral percentage, explains where pending bonuses appear, and identifies a seven-day release period. The binary reward likewise requires a defined qualification: one person on each side and a stated personal position. Crucially, the supplied material does not show a request for passwords or payment credentials, a guaranteed return, a promised outcome for every participant, or an actual payout. It describes bonus accounting and eligibility, not proof of a scam mechanism.

citations.quote: refer other people you will get a 10% direct referral bonus
You will also need to have at least $200 in your own position.
the waiting period for the binary bonuses, just like the referral commissions, is seven days.
You decide either way but try to get your Bitcoin to work for you, whatever you choose to do.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The existence of referral rewards does not by itself prove fraud; many services use conditional referral promotions. Here, the video specifies the percentage, qualification, pending status, release timing, and available choices. The prosecution's description of left and right legs identifies the reward formula, but does not establish that recruitment income is the sole or fraudulent mechanism.

citations.quote: the current available bonuses which includes the pending bonuses.
You decide either way but try to get your Bitcoin to work for you, whatever you choose to do.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: This is not merely an incidental referral discount: the video calls referral and binary rewards separate streams of income, pays for introducing people on two organizational sides, and ties the binary payment to the smaller leg. The stated conditions make recruitment central rather than disproving the mechanism. Nor does a seven-day waiting period or an option to reinvest demonstrate that funds were actually paid.
